name: neotoma
description: Neotoma for Claude: a bundled MCP connector (defaults to the public sandbox; point it at your own Neotoma in the plugin settings), onboarding skills (setup, check, recover), starter commands, and Claude Code lifecycle hooks (Python, under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks). The same package also ships a Cursor hook map (.cursor/hooks.json -> cursor-hooks).

neotoma_mcp_url.title: Neotoma MCP URL
neotoma_mcp_url.description: The MCP endpoint of the Neotoma you want Claude to use, e.g. https://your-neotoma.example/mcp or http://127.0.0.1:3080/mcp. Leave empty to use the public sandbox (shared and ephemeral: do not store personal data there).
